body: From the DM-187 review (orchestrator, this run): corrective planner follow-ups to fix and pin — a prerequisite on a deselected experiment's work refuses every preview (improvementView.ts:334-345, CorrectivePlanner.tsx:488): leave out and report it; cleared criteria send [] and surface raw schema text (improvementView.ts:355, CorrectivePlanner.tsx:294): omit acceptanceCriteria when blank; Reset from a closed row drops focus to body (CorrectivePlanner.tsx:398-401,428-432); a dropped-target message can't be cleared by the already-checked radio (improvementView.ts:418); at 1024 px the 'Frozen with' report id overflows under the gate card. Pin planner helpers plannerRequest, editStanding, resultStands, shownNotice, fittingTarget.
